subject: VA disability claim stuck 19 months — please help
body:
Dear Congressman,

I am a Marine Corps veteran who filed a disability claim for service-connected PTSD and a lower-back injury in September 2024. It has now been 19 months and my claim is still showing 'Preparation for Decision' at the Atlanta Regional Office. I have called the 800 number seven times. Each time they tell me someone will call back within 10 business days. No one ever does. I can reach me at (404) 555-0188 or twhitaker1974@gmail.com. My file number is on record with VA. I live at 2418 Peachtree Ridge Rd, Atlanta GA 30303. My SSN is 247-33-8811.

I cannot keep waiting. I had to leave my job because of the back injury and my savings are almost gone.

Respectfully,
Thomas Whitaker

subject: PTSD claim — 14 months waiting at Atlanta RO
body:
Hello, I am reaching out because my VA disability claim for combat-related PTSD has been pending at the Atlanta Regional Office since February 2025. I was deployed to Iraq in 2007-2008 with the Army National Guard. My C&P exam was completed in June 2025 and since then there has been no update. My phone is 256-555-0134, email drob_al@yahoo.com. I live at 1105 Mapleton Drive, Huntsville AL 35805.

The VA call center tells me my case is 'awaiting rating decision' but won't say more. Please can your office check on this.

Thank you,
Denise Robinson

subject: Navy veteran — 22 month wait on knee claim (Atlanta RO)
body:
Senator,

I served 12 years in the Navy and was medically separated in 2022 for a torn meniscus and ACL damage from a shipboard injury. My VA compensation claim was filed June 2024 and is still pending at the Atlanta Regional Office. That is 22 months. I am 46 years old, cannot work construction anymore, and the VA keeps telling me 'we are waiting on evidence review.' They have all my evidence — I sent it twice.

Call me at (803) 555-0177 or email cmendoza.vet@outlook.com. I reside at 512 Gervais Street, Columbia SC 29201.

Thanks,
C. Mendoza

subject: Hearing loss claim — Atlanta RO, 16 months
body:
Dear Representative,

Air Force veteran here, Robins AFB, served 1998-2018. Filed a claim for bilateral sensorineural hearing loss from flight line work 16 months ago. Still pending at Atlanta. Every month I log into VA.gov and it says the same thing. I have attempted to contact the Atlanta RO directly five times, been hung up on three times.

Contact: 478-555-0149, jfletcher.usaf@gmail.com, address 147 Warner Robins Way, Warner Robins GA 31088. DOB: 4/11/1976.

I am asking for your office to make a Congressional inquiry. Thank you.

James Fletcher, SMSgt USAF (Ret)

subject: TBI claim pending at Atlanta VA regional office
body:
I am an Army veteran, served 2007-2015, deployed Afghanistan. I have a diagnosed traumatic brain injury from a 2011 IED blast. My VA claim was filed in May 2025, 11 months ago. It is pending at the Atlanta Regional Office. My C&P neuropsych exam was supposed to be scheduled in October 2025 and never was. I have called to reschedule three times. Each time I'm told 'we'll send a letter.' No letters arrive.

I can be reached at rokonjo85@protonmail.com, cell 678-555-0112. I live at 3804 Westside Commons, Atlanta GA 30318.

Thanks,
Rebecca

subject: 18 months — Atlanta VA RO back injury claim
body:
To whom it may concern,

My name is Michael Pham, former USMC, Charleston native. I was injured in a training accident in 2019 (herniated L4-L5). I filed my disability claim in October 2024 and it remains at the Atlanta Regional Office. 18 months. My back is getting worse. The VA told my brother (who was on the phone with me) that the RO is 'understaffed and backlogged.'

That may be true but I need a decision. Phone (843) 555-0166, email mpham_marines@icloud.com, mailing 28 Magnolia Crescent Ln, North Charleston SC 29405. Please help.

Semper Fi,
Michael Pham

subject: Widow of veteran — DIC claim pending at Atlanta RO
body:
My husband Willard was a Vietnam-era Army veteran who passed away in January 2025 from service-connected heart disease. I filed for Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) at that time, 15 months ago. My claim is pending at the Atlanta Regional Office. I am 71 years old and have no other income beyond Social Security. The mortgage is getting hard.

My phone is 912-555-0121, email sbooker.ga@aol.com, address 706 Bull Street, Savannah GA 31401. Our marriage certificate and his DD-214 and death certificate are all on file.

Can you please make an inquiry with VA on my behalf.

Sincerely,
Sharon Booker

subject: SSA stopped my retirement benefits — reason code 88
body:
I am 77 years old. I have received my Social Security retirement check every month since 2011. In March 2026 the deposit did not arrive. I called SSA and after two hours I was told my benefits were suspended under 'reason code 88.' No one could explain what that meant or what I am supposed to do. I was told a letter is in the mail. That was four weeks ago. No letter.

I live on this check. I am now behind on rent. Please can your office find out what happened. Phone (415) 555-0193, email echen1948@gmail.com, address 1127 Valencia Street Apt 4B, San Francisco CA 94110. SSN ends in -4477.

Thank you,
Edith Chen

subject: SSDI reduced $400/month without explanation — reason code 88
body:
My SSDI payment was reduced by about $400 a month starting in February 2026. The letter I received references 'reason code 88' and 'prior overpayment recovery.' I have never been overpaid. I have submitted a reconsideration request through my SSA field office in Austin and have heard nothing back in 11 weeks.

Reach me: 512-555-0108, hpenn.tx@gmail.com. I live at 3301 South Congress Ave Apt 12, Austin TX 78701. I am 59 and have been on SSDI since 2019 for multiple sclerosis.

Thank you for any help,
Harold

subject: SSA claims I owe $12,000 — reason code 88 letter
body:
Good afternoon. I got a letter from Social Security dated March 14, 2026 saying I was overpaid $12,040 between 2022 and 2024 and that they will begin withholding my entire monthly benefit starting May 2026 to recover it. The letter cites 'reason code 88.' I do not understand this. I have been receiving the same benefit since 2017 based on the same work history and I have always reported any income promptly.

My phone: (718) 555-0103. Email: lokafor.bk@gmail.com. Home: 44 Court St Apt 1104, Brooklyn NY 11201.

If they withhold my full benefit I will lose my apartment. Please help.

Linda Okafor

subject: Survivor benefits frozen — cited reason code 88
body:
My wife passed away in November 2025. I began receiving survivor benefits from Social Security in January. In April my deposit did not come. The SSA office tells me my benefits are on hold pending 'reason code 88 review.' They cannot tell me how long this will take.

Please — I am 68, recently widowed, and this is my primary income. Contact me at 305-555-0175, wjorg.fl@yahoo.com, 888 Collins Ave Apt 7, Miami Beach FL 33139.

Respectfully,
Walter Jorgensen

subject: Social Security stopped — 'reason code 88' and I cannot get answers
body:
To my Representative:

My monthly Social Security disability payment did not deposit in March 2026 or April 2026. When I call SSA I am told the payment was suspended under 'reason code 88' and my case is in 'post-entitlement review.' I have been trying to get a local office appointment for six weeks.

I have end-stage renal disease and rely on this income for transportation to dialysis three times a week. This is an emergency.

Reach: (312) 555-0144, yalvarez.il@outlook.com, address 1802 W 18th St, Chicago IL 60608. SSN xxx-xx-2209.

Yolanda Alvarez

subject: Medicare was billed $3,500 for a scooter I never received
body:
I am 74 and on Medicare. I received my quarterly Medicare Summary Notice and it shows a charge of $3,487.22 from a company called 'Premier Mobility Solutions' for a 'power mobility scooter' supposedly delivered to me on February 9, 2026. I never ordered a scooter. I never received a scooter. My doctor never prescribed one.

I called the number on the notice and the person who answered said 'we'll look into it' and hung up. The company's address on the notice is in Miami Lakes FL but the notice says the equipment was delivered to my home in Philadelphia.

Contact me: (215) 555-0186, ebishop.pa@verizon.net, 1906 Spruce Street, Philadelphia PA 19103.

This feels like fraud. I want it investigated.

Eleanor Bishop

subject: Strange Medicare charges from Premier Mobility Solutions — oxygen I don't use
body:
Hello, my name is Gerald Hoffman, I am 81, and my Medicare statement shows monthly rental charges of $182/month for 'portable oxygen concentrator — rental' from a company called Premier Mobility Solutions. I do not use oxygen. I have never been prescribed oxygen. I have no lung condition. The charges go back to January 2025.

That is over $2,500 billed to Medicare for equipment I do not have.

My phone (216) 555-0199, ghoffman.oh@gmail.com, address 1300 East 9th Street Unit 702, Cleveland OH 44114. Medicare number ends in -9916.

Please have this investigated.

Gerald Hoffman

subject: Medicare billed for hospital bed I never got — Premier Mobility Solutions
body:
Dear Congresswoman,

I received a Medicare Summary Notice showing a one-time charge of $2,199 from 'Premier Mobility Solutions' for a 'semi-electric hospital bed' allegedly delivered to my home on January 28, 2026. I live in a second-floor apartment and no hospital bed has been delivered to my home at any time. My primary care doctor confirmed he never wrote such an order.

The delivery address on the notice is a different street in Detroit — not my address.

My information: Margaret Sullivan, age 78, 3905 Woodward Ave Apt 12, Detroit MI 48202. Phone (313) 555-0154, email msullivan.mi@yahoo.com. Medicare number ending -7732.

I believe this is Medicare fraud and I want the matter referred.

Margaret Sullivan

subject: Medicare still being billed for my deceased cousin — same supplier keeps charging
body:
My cousin Theodore Delacroix died March 2023. I am the executor of his estate. In going through his mail I discovered Medicare was still being billed after his death. Specifically, a company called Premier Mobility Solutions billed Medicare $410 a month from April 2023 through at least February 2026 for 'durable medical equipment rental.' That is nearly three years of billing for a man who has been deceased.

I reported this to 1-800-MEDICARE in November 2025. I never heard anything back.

Contact: Frank Delacroix, (504) 555-0115, fdelacroix.la@gmail.com, 2218 Magazine St, New Orleans LA 70115.

This is theft. Please refer to the HHS Inspector General.

Frank Delacroix

subject: USCIS green card renewal (I-90) delayed 14 months
body:
Hello, I submitted my I-90 green card renewal in February 2025. It has been 14 months. My current card expired in November. My employer's HR department has flagged an E-Verify issue. I have scheduled a biometrics appointment twice — both times the USCIS office rescheduled. Most recent letter was dated January 2026 and said 'case under review.' No further update.

Receipt number MSC2490178432. Contact (206) 555-0138, jpark.sea@gmail.com, 814 Pike Street Apt 502, Seattle WA 98101.

Jenna Park

subject: IRS lost my 2022 tax return — refund held hostage
body:
I filed my 2022 federal return on paper in April 2023. It was never processed. The IRS confirms they 'have no record' of the return. I filed a second copy (certified mail) in August 2023. Still no record. I am owed a refund of approximately $4,200.

Every time I call the IRS I spend 2-3 hours on hold and then am told to 'resubmit.' I am out of patience.

Derek Ajayi, (919) 555-0122, dajayi.nc@outlook.com, 115 E Edenton St, Raleigh NC 27601. SSN xxx-xx-6641.

subject: HUD Section 8 voucher not being processed by local PHA
body:
I was approved for a Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher in August 2025. My local Public Housing Authority has failed to issue the voucher for nine months. I have provided every document requested, multiple times. I am currently housing-insecure and staying with my sister. I am asking for Congressional assistance to escalate to HUD's Portland Field Office.

Patricia Hollis, age 52, phone (503) 555-0177, email phollis.or@gmail.com, current address c/o J. Hollis, 923 NW Kearney St, Portland OR 97205.

subject: Repeated USPS mail theft — checks and medication stolen
body:
I have had at least six pieces of mail stolen from my building's mailbox cluster in the last four months, including two Social Security checks, a replacement debit card, and prescription medication. USPS Postal Inspection Service took my report in January but I have heard nothing. My neighbors have had similar experiences.

Andre Beaumont, (612) 555-0168, abeaumont.mn@yahoo.com, 1200 Washington Ave S Apt 804, Minneapolis MN 55401.

Please follow up.
